 Co-Diagnostics Receives Logix Smart® ZDC Test Order from Peru Distributor as Dengue Cases Rise and Exhibits at MEDICA 2026 in Düsseldorf 
 Co-Diagnostics Receives Logix Smart® ZDC Test Order from Peru Distributor as Dengue Cases Rise and Exhibits at MEDICA 2026 in Düsseldorf 
 Provided by PR Newswire 2026년 11월 17일 오후 2:00:00 
 Co-Diagnostics Receives Logix Smart® ZDC Test Order from Peru Distributor as Dengue Cases Rise and Exhibits at MEDICA 2026 in Düsseldorf
 Co-Diagnostics Receives Logix Smart® ZDC Test Order from Peru Distributor as Dengue Cases Rise and Exhibits at MEDICA 2026 in Düsseldorf 
 PR Newswire 
 SALT LAKE CITY, Nov. 17, 2026 
 Company Also Ships Logix Smart ZDC Tests for Study in Bolivia 
 Co-Dx to Meet with International Customers and Distributors at World Trade Center Utah Booth 
 SALT LAKE CITY , Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Co-Diagnostics, Inc. (Nasdaq: CODX) ("Co-Dx" or "the Company"), a molecular diagnostics company with a unique, patented platform for the development of molecular diagnostic tests, today announced that its distributor in Peru has placed a new order for its Logix Smart® ZDC (ZIKV-DENV-CHIKV) test as the country experiences a rise in dengue activity, and shipped Logix Smart® ZDC tests purchased by a European organization for use in a study in Bolivia. The Company is also exhibiting at MEDICA 2026, taking place November 16–19 in Düsseldorf, Germany. 
 In Peru, the Company's distributor recently placed a new order for the Logix Smart ZDC test as the country experiences a rise in dengue activity. According to the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), Peru has reported 83,430 dengue cases in 2026 through epidemiological week 42, and cases reported that week were up 51% compared with the average of the previous four weeks. 
 In Bolivia, the tests were purchased by a European organization for a study in collaboration with a prominent laboratory in Bolivia. Co-Dx also continues to supply real-time PCR instruments to its distributor in Bolivia, with approximately 17 units shipped since the beginning of 2025. 
 The Logix Smart ZDC test is a real-time RT-PCR test that uses the Company's patented Co-Primers ®  technology to detect and differentiate between Zika, dengue and chikungunya viruses, which are spread by mosquitoes and often present with similar symptoms. The test has been CE-IVD marked since 2019 and is available for sale in the European Union and other markets that accept CE-IVD marking. It is not available for sale in the United States.  
 "New orders for our Logix Smart ZDC test in South America reflect the need for a multiplex CE-IVD marked assay that detects and differentiates Zika, dengue and chikungunya," said Dwight Egan, Chief Executive Officer of Co-Diagnostics. "These orders put our technology to work in regions where these mosquito-borne diseases are a public health concern. MEDICA gives our team direct access to the customers and distributors who drive our international business, and we are in Düsseldorf this week to build those relationships."  
 Co-Dx is exhibiting at MEDICA 2026 as part of the World Trade Center Utah booth at Stand 16E24-1 in Hall 16. MEDICA is one of the world's largest trade fairs for medical technology and healthcare, drawing international exhibitors across diagnostics, laboratory equipment and health IT. Co-Dx has exhibited at MEDICA several times, and the event is a key meeting point with customers and distributors from South Asia and the Middle East, two of the Company's main target markets. 
 "Success in global business comes to those who show up," said World Trade Center Utah," said Jonathan Freedman, President and CEO of World Trade Center Utah. "International trade shows like MEDICA put companies face-to-face with the customers, distributors and partners who can drive their next stage of growth. At World Trade Center Utah, we help businesses like Co-Diagnostics make those connections and turn global opportunities into business results. We're excited to see what comes from their participation at MEDICA and the relationships they build along the way." 
 Co-Dx is also hosting two webinars today: one for potential customers of its Vector Smart™ mosquito surveillance solutions, and one through CoSara Diagnostics, the Company's joint venture in India, on HPV and cervical cancer screening in recognition of World Cervical Cancer Elimination Day. For more information about either webinar, please contact info@co-dx.com . 
 About Co-Diagnostics, Inc.: Co-Diagnostics, Inc., a Utah corporation, is a molecular diagnostics company that develops, manufactures and markets state-of-the-art diagnostics technologies. The Company's technologies are utilized for tests that are designed using the detection and/or analysis of nucleic acid molecules (DNA or RNA). The Company also uses its proprietary technology to design specific tests for its Co-Dx PCR at-home and point-of-care platform (subject to regulatory review and not currently for sale) and to identify genetic markers for use in applications other than infectious disease.
